column2:
[title22][sentence]
The large vertical support prevents the
overhead structure from falling on you.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這根粗壯的直立支柱撐著上方結構，
沒讓它砸到你頭上。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Since this teleporter is built into
the wall, you see little through the
viewport.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n這台傳送器是嵌在牆裡的，\n觀景窗能看到的東西不多。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The keypad has twelve keys on it.
The numerals zero through nine are
present, as well as 'smile' and 'frown'
keys.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這個鍵盤上有十二個按鍵，
0到9的數字鍵都有，
另外還有「笑臉」跟「哭臉」鍵。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This is entry device is about
as complicated as a pocket
calculator.  Take your time;
you'll get it eventually.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這台輸入裝置，
複雜程度大概跟
計算機差不多。
別急，你遲早會弄懂的。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt's a key.  Hint: It's about the same\nsize as the tip of a human finger.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這是一把鑰匙。提示：
大小差不多跟
人類指尖一樣。

column2:
[title17][sentence]
You are standing inside an
alien teleportation device.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
你正站在一台
外星傳送裝置裡面。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThis must signify the 'blue light special'\nthe store was running on selected software.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這想必就是店家幫特選軟體\n打的「破盤特賣」燈號。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You have always wanted one of these
for your bedroom.  You had better
find yourself a new bedroom first.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你一直很想在房間
擺一台這個。不過你得先
弄到一間新房間才行。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You are surprised to see that "Polyester
Suit Peter," is still around.  You dream
of starring in your own action-packed
graphic adventure some day.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你很意外「聚酯西裝彼得」
這牌子還沒倒。你夢想有天
自己也能主演一款
動作滿載的圖像冒險遊戲。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The old software runs on a computer
platform that hasn't been available in decades.
You had better visit a store that has updated
its inventory this century.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這套舊軟體得靠
幾十年前就絕跡的電腦平台
才能跑。你最好找一家
這世紀有更新庫存的店。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe back wall of the store is littered with\nlittle flyers and posters.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n店裡的後牆貼滿了\n零零散散的傳單跟海報。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
It's an advertisement for a game called:
"Nasty Nick takes on the Bronx."  It
looks like an arcade shoot-em-up.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這是一款遊戲的廣告：
《下流尼克大戰布朗克斯》，
看起來像是台街機射擊遊戲。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nIn large purple letters the sign announces\nthe name of the software store.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n招牌上用大大的紫色字\n寫著這家軟體店的店名。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Hmmm.  A flight sim, an adventure game,
a 'pretend-you're-in-a-movie' game, a
'gee-I-wish-I-really-knew-how-to-use-a-sword'
game, and various other escapist entertainment
packages adorn the walls here.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
嗯……飛行模擬器、冒險遊戲、
「假裝自己在演電影」遊戲、
「真希望我會用劍」遊戲，
還有各種逃避現實的
娛樂軟體，擺滿了這面牆。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This shelf is covered with word processors,
spreadsheets, databases, communications
packages, and other boring items.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這層架上擺滿文書處理軟體、
試算表、資料庫、通訊軟體，
還有其他一堆無聊東西。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These appear to be anti-shoplifting
sensors.  Walking through them with
an unpaid-for software package would
probably be unwise.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些看起來像是
防盜感應器。帶著沒付錢的
軟體從這裡走過去，
大概不是什麼聰明的做法。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThe registers look like normal retail\npoint-of-sale cash registers.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n收銀機看起來就是\n普通零售用的收銀台。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Something is written here, but you
can't read the handwriting.  It looks
likes cuneiform.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡寫了些什麼，但你
看不懂那筆跡，
看起來像楔形文字。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
This is obviously a computer software
store.  They seem to specialize in
personal productivity software and
games.  Productivity.  Hmph.  What a
waste of computer hardware.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這顯然是一間電腦軟體店，
主打個人生產力軟體
跟遊戲。生產力。哼，
真是浪費電腦硬體。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The cash register doesn't have a 'no sale' key, so
you decide not to embarrass yourself
by spending hours trying to figure out
how to get the drawer open.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這台收銀機沒有「不結帳」鍵，
你決定別花好幾個小時
研究怎麼把抽屜打開，
免得丟人現眼。

[title33][sentence]
天啊這裡塞爆了。讓我看看：
《貨船指揮官》（附「秘密貨艙」
任務片）、克里尼克托夫斯普特蘭迪亞、
《F-98 III》、《執行長的請求》、
《模擬腸道》、《支票簿的平衡》、
《究極羅馬數字》、《超級塗鴉高手》
（八吋磁片版）、《桌面鼴鼠》、
《方塊伯特》、《酥胸奇兵24》、
一本OS-2攻略本。
這裡少說有二十幾款遊戲。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe large window yields a beautiful\npanoramic view of the city.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這扇大窗戶，
能將整座城市的美景
盡收眼底。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You struggle for a minute on
the first few letters, but you eventually
manage to sound out all the words.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
一開始的幾個字讓你
卡了好一會兒，但你最終
還是把每個字都拼出來了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nOn the counters you see cash registers,\na pad, and a jar of pencils.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n櫃檯上擺著收銀機、\n一本便條紙，還有一罐鉛筆。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nOn the counters you see cash registers,\na pad, a jar of pencils, and a small penlight.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
櫃檯上擺著收銀機、
一本便條紙、一罐鉛筆，
還有一支筆型手電筒。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nIt is a small metal cylinder with a\nbulb at one end.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n這是一根小小的金屬圓筒，\n一端還有個燈泡。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nYou pick up the penlight and put\nit in your pocket.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n你撿起筆型手電筒，\n塞進口袋裡。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis evidently illuminates the exit in\nthe event of a power failure.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這顯然是在停電時\n用來照亮出口的東西。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Uh oh.  You are less disturbed by the
skeleton itself than by the fact that no
one has removed it.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
糟了。讓你毛的不是這具
骷髏本身，而是居然
沒人把它清走。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This appears to be an elevator shaft.  The
distinct lack of an elevator renders the
shaft useless.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這看起來是電梯井。
很明顯電梯不見了，
這口井也就沒什麼用了。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
This shaft doesn't go too far down,
but extends up beyond the limits of
your eyesight.  You experience a brief
flash of acrophobia and decide not to
try climbing up the shaft.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這口井往下不算深，
往上卻高得看不到頂。
你突然一陣懼高，
決定不要爬上去試試看。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
From where you are now standing the
building appears to be sound.  Of
course, you can only tell so much
by looking at one exterior wall.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
從你現在站的地方看，
這棟建築似乎還算堅固。
當然，光看一面外牆，
你也看不出多少名堂。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You can easily understand why this now-familiar
device is the preferred mode of transportation
on this planet.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你不難理解，為什麼這個
你已經很熟悉的裝置，
會是這顆星球上
最愛用的交通工具。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nTo the west you see what might be a\ncar.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n西邊你看到一個\n可能是車子的東西。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nTo the west you see the a car parked\non the street.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n西邊的街上停著\n一輛車。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
It soon becomes clear that you are
not on an island. Nor are you
underground.  Air tainted by the
smell of decay reaches your nostrils.
A skeleton on the railing nearby, in
addition to the unnerving silence everywhere
gives you the feeling that something is
wrong here.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你很快就看清楚，自己
既不在島上，也不在
地底下。一股帶著腐臭的
空氣鑽進你的鼻子。
附近欄杆上還掛著一具
骷髏，加上四周詭異的
寂靜，讓你覺得這裡
八成出了什麼問題。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe sidewalk continues west toward the center of the city.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n人行道繼續往西\n通向市中心。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou are getting used to seeing equipment\nyou can't make heads nor tails of.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你已經漸漸習慣
看到一堆你完全看不懂的
設備了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The railing surrounds what might once have been
some kind of observation post.  Apparently its
sole remaining purpose involves holding a
skeleton off the ground.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這欄杆圍著的地方，
以前大概是某種觀測站。
如今它唯一的功能，
似乎就是撐著一具
骷髏，不讓它倒地。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThe important information spewing forth\nfrom this monitor is meaningless to you.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這台螢幕上不斷冒出
看似重要的資訊，
對你來說毫無意義。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nFrom the smell in here you presume that\nthe air purifier is not working properly.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
從這裡的味道判斷，
你猜空氣清淨機
大概故障了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The lab contains a great deal of
equipment, little of which you
know anything about.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
實驗室裡擺滿了各種
設備，但你幾乎
一樣都不認得。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This appears to be some sort
of emergency power switch.  Open
contact switches make you a little
nervous--if you grab the wrong part . . . .
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這看起來是某種
緊急電源開關。裸露的
接點讓你有點緊張——
萬一抓錯地方的話……

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You had better not.  If the lights go out
you'll just end up walking into things
and will probably hurt yourself.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你最好別這麼做。
燈一滅，你大概就會
撞得到處都是，
搞不好還會受傷。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You wonder how long this has been 
sitting here.  You are reminded of the
condiments in your refrigerator.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你很好奇這東西
在這裡放了多久，
讓你想起自己冰箱裡
那些調味料。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Of all the things you'd like to pick
up and carry around with you for a
while, toxic waste is near the bottom
of the list.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
在你想隨身帶著走的
東西清單裡，有毒廢棄物
大概排在
倒數幾名。

column2:
[title18][sentence]
The board is covered with empirical formulae,
none of which you understand.  You think the
one on the bottom may describe the molecular
structure of a chocolate malt, but you can't be sure.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
這塊板子寫滿了
實驗公式，你一個都
看不懂。你猜最下面那條
大概是巧克力麥芽
奶昔的分子結構，
但也不太確定。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Underneath each of the glass domes is a brain
pickled in formaldehyde.  The labels underneath
the domes read "Citron brain", "Motron brain", and
"Human brain".  The human brain appears to be
significantly smaller than the others.  The exact
nature of the experiment escapes you, but you
decide you'd rather not participate in it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
每個玻璃罩底下都泡著
一顆用福馬林醃著的腦。
罩子下方的標籤寫著
「西特隆腦」、「莫特隆腦」，
還有「人腦」。人腦看起來
比其他兩顆小上不少。
你搞不懂這實驗到底在
幹嘛，但你決定還是
別自願參一腳。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Harking back to your high school chemistry days,
you recall that this compound is a highly
volatile oxidizer, or is it an acid?  No, wait,
it's . . . Hmmm.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
回想起高中化學課，
你記得這種化合物
是種高揮發性氧化劑，
還是酸？不對，等等，
它是……嗯。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou CAREFULLY pick up the flask.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你萬分小心地\n拿起了燒瓶。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This little alcove has an exhaust fan, and
looks like it was designed for the mixing
of volatile chemicals.  There is a small
kettle inside the alcove.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這個小凹室裝了
抽風扇，看起來是專門
設計來調和揮發性化學品的。
凹室裡還有一個小茶壺。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe label reads "Formaldehyde".
column3: [title19][sentence]\n標籤上寫著\n「福馬林」。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe label reads "Lecithin", but you\nremember little about phosphatides.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
標籤上寫著「卵磷脂」，
但你對磷脂類化合物
幾乎沒什麼印象。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nYou carefully pick up the flask.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你小心地\n拿起燒瓶。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe kettle is empty but you reason\nthat it must be a mixing vessel.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n茶壺是空的，但你推斷\n這應該是個調和用的容器。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe kettle contains some liquid.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n茶壺裡裝著\n一些液體。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nEureka!  You have managed to reproduce\nthe professor's explosive formula!  Now what?
column3:
[title27][sentence]
我懂了！你竟然成功
重現了教授的爆炸物
配方！接下來呢？

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou do not need to carry around a heavy\nkettle.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你不需要\n扛著一個沉重的茶壺到處走。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
This panel must regulate the various
experiments being performed in this
lab.  You decide to leave the thing
alone before you hurt yourself.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這面板想必是用來
控制這間實驗室裡
進行的各種實驗。你決定
別亂碰，免得傷到自己。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
Hey!  This looks and smells fresh.  This must
be where that explosion occurred while you
were 'chatting' with Doc Slache's intern.
Whatever caused this was potent stuff.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
嘿！這裡看起來還聞起來
都很新鮮。這裡想必就是
你跟史萊奇醫師的助理
「聊天」時炸開的地方。
不管是什麼東西搞的，
威力都不小。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis leads out into the corridor\nin front of the laboratory.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這裡通往\n實驗室外的走廊。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
This appears to be a research laboratory
of some kind.  There is an experiment in
progress on one bench, a little alcove with
a kettle in it, and a large scorch mark on
the floor.  One would presume that something
exploded on the floor over there.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這裡看起來是某種
研究實驗室。一張工作台上
正進行著實驗，
一個小凹室裡放著茶壺，
地板上還有一大片焦痕。
看樣子那邊曾經
炸過什麼東西。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThe air horn must signal break time.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這個空氣喇叭\n想必是在宣布休息時間。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nWhatever blew the floor open scattered\npieces of it around the room.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
不管是什麼東西
把地板炸開的，碎片
散落了滿地都是。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nJudging by the temperature in here the\nheater must be working.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n從這裡的溫度判斷，\n暖氣應該是有在運轉的。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThere are numerous pipes connecting\nthings to the walls.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n好幾根管線\n把東西接到牆上。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The sink is incredibly clean.  It's either
new, recently cleaned, or used to dispose
of potent acids.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這個水槽乾淨得誇張。
不是全新的，就是剛清過，
或者是專門用來
倒強酸的。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
Don't do that.  Surely you can find
something more productive to do with
the [noun1].
column3:
[title22][sentence]
別這麼做。你一定能找到
[noun1]更有建設性的
用法。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nAlthough a new brain is not a bad idea,\nyou haven't a clue how to install one.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
換一顆新腦袋雖然
不是壞主意，但你完全
不知道要怎麼裝。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Electrical energy is arcing between
the electrodes.  Beyond this observation,
you have no insights into the purpose
of this little light show.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
電流正在電極之間
打火放電。除了看出這點，
你完全搞不懂這場
小小燈光秀的用意。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Touching metal objects that are throwing
eighteen-inch sparks would probably be
the stupidest thing you've done in a long time.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
去摸會噴出十八吋
火花的金屬物體，大概是你
近期做過最蠢的事。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You gingerly pour the contents of the
kettle into the two charge cases.  You
made just enough explosives to fill them
both.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你小心翼翼地把茶壺裡的
東西倒進兩個裝藥盒。
你做的炸藥量，剛好
夠裝滿這兩個盒子。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
You don't have anything to
put the explosives in.  You
need something designed to
hold explosives, as opposed
to a shoe, or a hat or something
equally ridiculous.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你沒有東西可以拿來
裝炸藥。你需要專門
設計來裝炸藥的容器，
而不是鞋子、帽子，
或其他同樣荒謬的東西。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou see little.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你看不太清楚。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The keypad has twelve keys on it.
The numerals zero through nine are
present, as well as 'smile' and 'frown'
keys.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這個鍵盤上有十二個按鍵，
0到9的數字鍵都有，
另外還有「笑臉」跟「哭臉」鍵。

column2:
[title17][sentence]
This entry device is about
as complicated as a pocket
calculator.  Take your time;
you'll get it eventually.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
這台輸入裝置，
複雜程度大概跟
計算機差不多。
別急，你遲早會弄懂的。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nIt's a key.  Hint: it's about the same\nsize as the tip of a human finger.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這是一把鑰匙。提示：
大小差不多跟
人類指尖一樣。

column2:
[title17][sentence]
You are standing in an
alien teleportation device.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
你正站在
一台外星傳送裝置裡。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The scanner is built into the hallway
in such a way that you cannot travel
farther without passing through it.  It
looks rather menacing from here.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這台掃描器嵌在走廊裡，
擋住去路，你得穿過它
才能繼續往前走。
從這裡看，它顯得相當
有威脅感。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou conclude from your past experiences\nthat this is some kind of gender scanner.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
根據你過去的經驗，
你判斷這是某種
性別掃描器。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The door looks extremely solid.  It must be
locked from the inside.  You don't see
any mechanism for unlocking it from
out here.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這扇門看起來非常堅固，
想必是從裡面鎖上的。
你在外面找不到任何
可以解鎖的機關。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe hallway south leads around a corner\nand out of sight.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n南邊的走廊繞過一個\n轉角，消失在視線外。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou see a large, familiar-looking saw blade\nat the end of the corridor to the north.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n你看到北邊走廊盡頭\n有一片眼熟的大鋸片。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
There is an odd looking scanner in the middle
of the corridor.  You also notice a large metal
door.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
走廊中間有一台
造型古怪的掃描器，
你還注意到一扇
大鐵門。

column2: [title14][sentence]\nThe trash smells awful.
column3: [title14][sentence]\n垃圾臭得要命。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYech!  Considering a career change?
column3: [title22][sentence]\n噁！是在考慮\n轉行嗎？

column2: [title17][sentence]\nIt's a safe bet this is what operates\nthe adjoining door.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n十之八九，這東西\n就是用來開旁邊那扇門的。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe [noun1] doesn't fit.  You must\nneed something different.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
[noun1]不合用。
你需要的顯然是
別的東西。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
"In case of fire break glass--then run like 
hell."  It appears someone has already used
the extinguisher.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
「如遇火警請擊破玻璃——
然後拔腿狂奔。」看來
已經有人用過
這具滅火器了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nSorry.  It's actually only a container for a fire\nextinguisher.  It's empty.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
抱歉，這其實只是個
滅火器的置放箱，
裡面是空的。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThe corridor continues for several yards in\na northeast direction, then turns due north.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n走廊往東北方向延伸了\n幾碼，接著轉向正北。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe corridor continues west.  You see\nmore doors in that direction.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n走廊繼續往西延伸，\n那個方向還有更多的門。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The place reeks of rotten garbage and
burnt hair.  Several doors line the north
wall, and there is some debris at the
eastern end of the corridor.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡瀰漫著腐爛垃圾
跟燒焦毛髮的臭味。
北邊牆上排著幾扇門，
走廊東端還堆著一些殘骸。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe walls here are solid rock.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n這裡的牆壁\n是堅硬的岩石。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
There are two doors here.  The western door
is marked 'storage room' and has an 
electronic card slot next to it.  The eastern
door has carbon scoring under it, leading
you to believe that there has been an explosion
here recently.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這裡有兩扇門。西邊的門
標示著「儲藏室」，
旁邊還有一個電子卡插槽。
東邊的門下方有焦黑痕跡，
讓你猜測這裡最近
發生過爆炸。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
There are two doors here.  The western door
is now open.  The eastern door has
carbon scoring under it, leading you to believe
that there has been an explosion here recently.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡有兩扇門。西邊的門
現在已經打開了。
東邊的門下方有焦黑痕跡，
讓你猜測這裡最近
發生過爆炸。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nPerhaps you should take a closer look\nat this door.  Do it; for your nose's sake.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你或許該仔細
看看這扇門。看吧，
就當是為了你的鼻子好。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This is yet another of the many
device around here whose purpose
escapes you.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這又是這附近眾多
讓你搞不懂用途的
裝置之一。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThis signpost was obviously smashed\nby the large boulder next to it.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
這根路標顯然是被
旁邊那顆大石頭
砸壞的。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nYou don't need it--it's broken.  Not that\nit would do you any good if it weren't.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你不需要它——反正也
壞了。就算沒壞，
對你大概也沒什麼用。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The boulder is large and heavy.  There is
a cavity in the roof of the same
general shape and size.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這顆石頭又大又重。
屋頂上有個凹洞，
形狀跟大小都差不多。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nSo now you think you're an Olympic\nweight lifter?
column3: [title16][sentence]\n現在是把自己\n當成奧運舉重選手了？

column2: [title18][sentence]\n"CAUTION:  Falling rock zone"
column3: [title18][sentence]\n「警告：落石區」

column2:
[title26][sentence]
And do what with it?  Mount it between the STOP
sign and the band posters over your cinder block
bookshelves?
column3:
[title26][sentence]
然後呢？把它掛在你那
磚塊書架上方，夾在
「停」字標誌跟樂團海報
中間嗎？

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThe contents of the barrels here are\na mystery to you.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這些桶子裡裝的東西，\n對你來說是個謎。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou don't need the barrels.  Besides,\nthey are too big to carry around.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你不需要這些桶子。
再說，它們也太大了，
沒辦法帶著走。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The markings on these barrels lead you to
believe that their contents may be in liquid form.
You quickly decide that opening them is not
a very good idea.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
桶子上的標記讓你猜測，
裡面裝的可能是液體。
你很快就打消了
打開它們的念頭。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThe rungs here are rolled up and tied\nfor storage.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n這裡的地毯捲起來\n綁好收在這裡。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You do not fancy yourself a decorator,
nor do you have anywhere to put a rug
just now.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你不覺得自己有
室內設計的天分，
現在也沒地方
擺地毯。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You notice something interesting in
one of the cartons.  The other cartons
do not appear to contain anything of
interest to you.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你注意到其中一個紙箱裡
有個有趣的東西。
其他紙箱看起來
沒什麼你感興趣的。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
Since you already scrounged
the charge cases the cartons
no longer contain anything that
interests you.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
既然你已經把
裝藥盒摸走了，
這些紙箱裡就沒有
你感興趣的東西了。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
There are three flour sacks: one almost
empty, the other two full.  Your baking
ability is practically non-existent, so flour
doesn't interest you much.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這裡有三袋麵粉：一袋
幾乎空了，另外兩袋
是滿的。你的烘焙功力
近乎於零，麵粉對你
沒什麼吸引力。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou don't have any time for baking.\nLeave the foodstuffs where they are.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你現在沒空烘焙。
食材就讓它們
待在原地吧。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
There are several green sacks lying around.
They look like they contain textiles of
some sort.  They could even be dirty
laundry.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡散落著幾個綠色
袋子，裡面裝的
看起來像是某種布料，
搞不好是待洗的髒衣服。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThey are probably dirty laundry.  You\ndon't need to play with them.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n它們八成是髒衣服。\n你不需要去碰它們。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The bucket of tar reminds you of a
punishment someone once said you
deserved.  It is black and sticky.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這桶瀝青讓你想起
曾經有人說過你活該
受到的某種懲罰。
又黑又黏。

column2: [title13][sentence]\nYech!  No thank you.
column3: [title13][sentence]\n噁！不用了，謝謝。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe can is emtpy, and looks like it\nmay even have a hole in it.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這個罐子是空的，\n看起來甚至還破了個洞。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou don't need any large empty\ncardboard canisters.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你不需要任何\n大型的空紙筒。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These look like standard charge cases
used to pack explosives.  They would
be extremely dangerous if they had anything
in them.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些看起來是標準的
裝藥盒，用來裝填炸藥。
要是裡面真的裝了東西，
那可就非常危險了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The fence was designed to keep
packages in and people out.  Right
now it appears to be doing it's job
quite nicely, thank you.  You spend
several minutes trying to find a way
through it, and several more trying
to cut it open.  Eventually you give
up, deciding that you really didn't
want to have to search through all
those little boxes.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這道圍籬設計來把貨物
關在裡面，把人擋在外面。
現在看來，它的工作
做得挺盡責的，謝了。
你花了好幾分鐘想找路
穿過去，又花了好幾分鐘
想把它剪開。最後你放棄了，
心想自己其實也沒那麼
想翻遍那堆小箱子。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe shelves hold many boxes.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n架子上擺著\n許多箱子。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe rat seems to be watching you.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這隻老鼠似乎\n在盯著你看。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nYou don't have any place\nto keep a pet.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n你沒有地方\n可以養寵物。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nLeave him alone.  He hasn't done\nanything to you.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n別去惹牠。\n牠又沒對你做什麼。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou pick up the charge cases and quickly\nexamine them.  They are empty.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你撿起裝藥盒，
快速檢查了一下。
是空的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
After looking around for a moment you
brilliantly deduce that this must be some
sort of storage room.  There are buckets,
carpets, sacks, barrels and even a rat here.
A strong-looking fence protects the bottom
shelves from unauthorized access.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
環顧四周片刻後，
你天才般地推斷出，
這裡想必是某種儲藏室。
這裡有水桶、地毯、
袋子、桶子，甚至還有
一隻老鼠。一道看起來
很堅固的圍籬，擋著
閒雜人等靠近下層架子。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIf you've never seen the side\nof a cliff, well, now you have.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
要是你從沒見過
懸崖側面，那現在
你算是見識到了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt reminds you of two gorgeous twins you\nonce dated named Sandy and Shelly.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這讓你想起以前交往過的
一對絕色雙胞胎，
珊蒂跟雪莉。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nShe's still up there.  Remember "Hell hath \nno fury..."
column3:
[title25][sentence]
她還在上面。
記得那句「地獄之火，
不及棄婦之怒」……
